item.title: Apple reports Q4 2026 earnings: $114.5 billion in revenue, up 12%
item.dc:creator: Priya Raman
item.description: CUPERTINO, Calif. — Apple reported fourth-quarter revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent, with a record for iPhone.
item.content:encoded:
CUPERTINO, Calif. — Apple on Tuesday reported fourth-quarter revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year earlier, as iPhone sales set a record for the quarter.

“We're thrilled with the response to iPhone Duo,” Tim Cook said in a statement. Services revenue rose to $28.1 billion.
